meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手通过原生适配器接入 Signal:不新增号码,而是以设备关联方式挂在你现有手机上,用那个号码收发消息,支持 Markdown、引用回复、DM 打字提示等。
howto.when: 当你要给助手添加 Signal 通道、执行该技能的设备关联步骤时触发;需 signal-cli 已在 PATH 或 $SIGNAL_CLI_PATH 可用。

say.text: 给助手加上 Signal,用我手机上的号码关联
say.note: 会启动设备关联并出二维码让你扫

say.text: 把刚发消息的那个 Signal 群接到我的 agent
say.note: 先查 messaging_groups 再创建 wiring

say.text: 这个 Signal 用户发消息被 not_member 挡了,给他授权
say.note: 创建用户并授予角色或加进组

howto.what_en: Assistant gains Signal through a native adapter: it links as a secondary device on your existing phone number via signal-cli, no new number. It sends and receives as that number; supports Markdown, quoted replies, DM typing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Signal as an assistant channel or run this skill's device-link step; signal-cli must be on PATH or at $SIGNAL_CLI_PATH.

say_en.text: Add Signal to my assistant using my phone's number
say_en.note: Starts device-link and shows a QR to scan

say_en.text: Wire the Signal group I just messaged to my agent
say_en.note: Look up messaging_groups, then create the wiring

say_en.text: Grant access to this Signal user blocked as not_member
say_en.note: Create the user and grant role or group access
